## Mova 1.10.0

新增实验性 Emby 兼容入口 `/emby` 及同名根路径别名，供第三方播放器沿用 Emby 连接方式。支持 Mova 账户登录、媒体库与电影/季/集浏览、图片、本地文件及 HTTP/HTTPS STRM 直播放、字幕、播放事件和续播。观看记录与 Mova 原生客户端共用；STRM 复用现有代理、访问限制和 Range 行为，上游地址及凭据不暴露给客户端。

设备 token 有效期为 90 天，注销、改密、停用或删除账户会撤销相应会话。播放会话防止停止后的迟到事件和旧会话覆盖较新的进度。兼容接口中的 `Version = 4.8.0.0` 仅是协议兼容标识，`MovaVersion` 返回实际构建版本。

此版本不代表完整 Emby Server 兼容；爆米花 macOS、iOS、安卓手机和安卓电视仍需实机验收。不提供转码、HLS、收藏、手动已看、NextUp 或远程控制。详见 [Emby 兼容接口与验收矩阵](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/blob/v1.10.0/docs/EMBY_COMPATIBILITY.md)。

包含迁移 0011，新增服务身份、设备元数据和临时播放会话。现有账户、媒体和观看记录原地保留，不需要重扫或重建缓存。原生 HTTP API 契约版本仍为 1。

运行时镜像移除应用不使用的 `util-linux`、`liblastlog2-2` 和 `libsqlite3-0`，清除 SQLite 的高风险依赖。基础镜像与应用镜像继续接受双架构运行验证和原有安全扫描；容器内宿主机登录、管理工具不属于受支持功能。

---

## Mova 1.10.0

Adds an experimental Emby-compatible `/emby` entry point and matching root-path aliases for third-party players. It supports Mova account login, library/movie/season/episode browsing, artwork, local-file and HTTP/HTTPS STRM direct playback, subtitles, playback events and resume. Progress is shared with native Mova clients. STRM retains existing proxy, access and Range policies without exposing upstream URLs or credentials to clients.

Device tokens last 90 days and are revoked by logout, password changes, account disabling or deletion. Playback sessions prevent late events after stopping and older sessions from overwriting newer progress. The compatibility response's `Version = 4.8.0.0` is a protocol identifier; `MovaVersion` reports the actual build.

This is not full Emby Server compatibility. Popcorn clients on macOS, iOS, Android phones and Android TV still require real-device acceptance testing. Transcoding, HLS, favorites, manual watched state, NextUp and remote control are outside this scope. See the [compatibility contract and acceptance matrix](https://github.com/RichesChiu/mova/blob/v1.10.0/docs/EMBY_COMPATIBILITY.md).

Migration 0011 adds server identity, device metadata and temporary playback sessions while preserving existing accounts, media and progress in place. No rescan or cache rebuild is required. The native HTTP API contract remains version 1.

The runtime image removes unused `util-linux`, `liblastlog2-2` and `libsqlite3-0` packages to eliminate the vulnerable SQLite dependency. Both runtime and application images retain dual-platform smoke tests and the existing security gate. Host login and administration utilities inside the container are outside the supported runtime contract.
